description.value:
Duration constant

A creature you have marked by any Deadhand ability, effect, or Trade feature gains no benefit from flanking you, from Aid, or from any circumstance bonus another creature grants it against you. It may still flank you for the purpose of its allies' own abilities; it simply gains nothing from doing so itself.

cinderfall.incomplete: The marked target gains no benefit from flanking/Aid/other circumstance bonuses against the caster specifically (still usable for the target's own other purposes). No selector suppresses a target's own received bonuses from the attacker's passive -- this is the inverse of granting the attacker a bonus, and is even further from any real precedent found in this pass -- compounded by this class's confirmed-unfireable mark predicate.
